description: A 3HP comparator, putting the result of comparing two voltages out on four gates

inputs.text: One of the two voltages compared; an empty jack counts as 0V

outputs.text: 10V while the voltage at input a is below the voltage at input b, 0V otherwise
10V while the two voltages are exactly equal, 0V otherwise
10V while the two voltages differ, 0V otherwise
10V while the voltage at input a is above the voltage at input b, 0V otherwise

notes: Mono only: a polyphonic cable patched in is read as its first channel alone, and each output carries one channel
